high_level_description: This image is a scientific visualization that appears to be from a research paper or presentation. It uses t-SNE (t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding) projections to visualize the embeddings of VFS (Visual Feature Space) data. The purpose of the visualization is to show how different configurations of an environment can cluster together based on their visual features, while ignoring task-irrelevant factors such as arm pose. Visual Elements: Main Plot: The central part of the image shows a 2D t-SNE projection with numerous blue dots scattered across the plot.
